versions.content: void SchM_[<client>_]<api>Hook_<bnsp>_[<vi>_<ai>]_ <name>_Return(<param>) Where <api> is the BSW Scheduler API Name (Send, Call, etc.), <bsnp> is the BSW Scheduler Name Prefix according [SWS_Rte_07593] and [SWS_Rte_07594], <vi> is the vendorId of the BSW module, <ai> is the vendorApiInfix of the BSW module and <name> is the name provided by the API (e.g. shortName of the VariableDataPrototype of a sender-receiver connection). The parameters of the API shall be the same as the corresponding BSW Scheduler API. The sub part in square brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module. See ([SWS_Rte_07528]).
